content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Technical Support-I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 07-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Technical Support-I post at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support-I position under this recruitment drive at AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support-I post is 28 years, with applicable relaxations for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Project Technical Support-I post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 18,000 plus HRA, as admissible under the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via Email. Candidates must send their complete bio-data and necessary documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category, including General, OBC, SC, or ST candidates, for the Project Technical Support-I recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by a Walk-In-Interview or Video Conferencing Interview and final document verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the date of the Walk-In-Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-In-Interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a 10th pass with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI) and 2 years of experience, or a Graduation degree with 1 year of experience in research projects.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the AIIMS Bhubaneswar official website or via the direct link provided in the Important Links section of this article.
